title: Rabbi Machasya bar Idi

paragraphs: In [Yoma 2a](https://www.sefaria.org/Yoma.2a.8), Rav Minyomi bar Chilkiya said in the name of Rabbi Machasya bar Idi, who said in the name of Rabbi Yochanan.[^1][^2]

notes.text: ב. gives Yoma 2a, not the older 2b placeholder. The exact William Davidson vocalized passage explicitly gives Rav Minyomi bar Chilkiya, Rabbi Machasya bar Idi, Rabbi Yochanan in that order.
The Gemara and [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2444&lang=en) place Rabbi Machasya between Rav Minyomi bar Chilkiya and Rabbi Yochanan in the chain of transmission.
